selection_rationale: Reviewer verdict 'pass'; strong feasibility/reproducibility scores and direct alignment with an identified gap (designing operational risk metrics for agentic NetOps). The study is narrowly scoped, falsifiable, and experiment/preregistration requirements are straightforward (train/test split, canary topology, calibration), increasing likelihood of producing a defensible five-page CNSM short paper within available compute/calls.
unresolved_uncertainties: External validity: will composite scores learned on synthetic/task-bank topologies generalize to production distributions and diverse vendor behaviors?
Canary simulation fidelity: how well do canary simulations predict full-deployment runtime risk across vendor/device heterogeneity?
Threshold transferability: to what extent do decision thresholds need per-organization tuning versus being broadly applicable?
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Pre-register exact submetric definitions (verifier-coverage fraction, canary-simulation pass criteria, rollback-success definition, LLM-confidence signal, abstention utility), training/validation/test splits, and regularization strategy (e.g., penalized logistic regression) with cross-validation procedure.
Specify canary topology size, fidelity constraints, and canary-vs-full simulation protocol; include ablation plan and out-of-sample generalization checks with bootstrapped confidence intervals.
Preregister decision-threshold selection rules and plan for decision-curve analysis and calibration reporting (Brier score, reliability diagrams).
